memory_candidates.summary: Every TM+ completeness engine's countermodel is a deterministic disjoint-lines frame (FlowFrame multiFamTaskFrameGen, zTaskFrameV2); any history-restricted modality collapses to the identity on them, so they cannot be reused for completeness of such extensions.

Pasting two total histories at a shared state (past of one, future of the other) is a total history using only TaskFrame.comp and TaskFrame.converse; pure-future/pure-past formula fragments are invariant under agreement on the corresponding half-line. This yields the valid pasting schemata for the stability modal.

Schema transfer by atomization: a modality whose truth depends only on the world state can be replaced by fresh state-valued atoms, so every TM+ axiom schema instantiated over the extended language is sound via the landed L+ soundness theorem in an expanded model on the same frame.
